
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/rockey627/p/20385305" title="发布于 2026-06-08 21:57">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">基于AScript的SQL脚本语言发布啦！</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<blockquote>
<p>说到执行动态脚本，大多使用Lua、Python、JS等语言，为什么没有SQL动态脚本语言呢？现在它来了！</p>
</blockquote>
<p data-pid="wrBfAhu8">AScript是一个开源的C#动态脚本解析执行引擎，支持扩展多种脚本语言，2026年6月8日正式发布了SQL脚本语言AScript.Lang.Sql，快来试试吧！</p>
<h2 id="h_2046348994746511585_0" data-into-catalog-status="">一、介绍</h2>
<p data-pid="uK1odXw2">支持SqlServer/MySql基础语法和数据类型：</p>
<ul>
<li data-pid="t9coxzYW">支持SELECT查询语法：<code>FROM/WHERE/LEFT JOIN/RIGHT JOIN/INNER JOIN/GROUP BY/ORDER BY/LIMIT</code></li>
<li data-pid="YrXQ0j1O">支持INSERT插入语法</li>
<li data-pid="sDAu5jqv">支持UPDATE修改语法</li>
<li data-pid="isWel_qN">支持DELETE删除语法</li>
<li data-pid="QqvbbRyt">支持创建存储过程：Sqlserver/MySql语法都支持</li>
<li data-pid="HpiVZw2P">支持创建表</li>
<li data-pid="qTovSrAj">支持定义变量</li>
<li data-pid="tsdEDgQY">字段名、关键字不区分大小写</li>
<li data-pid="ygpe7UCE">支持调用外部方法和变量</li>
<li data-pid="FTFeToy_">已内置常用数据类型：<code>tinyint/smallint/int/bigint/decimal/float/real/double/bit/char/nchar/varchar/nvarchar/text/datetime</code></li>
</ul>
<p data-pid="gEicvhfq">不支持：</p>
<ul>
<li data-pid="dBOVLm4R">存储过程暂不支持OUT参数</li>
<li data-pid="8zj_tLXf">SELECT查询不支持*号</li>
<li data-pid="2fty9G71">SELECT查询不支持聚合函数</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="h_2046348994746511585_1" data-into-catalog-status="">二、安装</h2>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">1</span> install-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">package AScript
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">2</span> install-package AScript.Lang.Sql</pre>
</div>
<h2 id="h_2046348994746511585_2" data-into-catalog-status="">三、使用说明</h2>
<h3 id="h_2046348994746511585_3" data-into-catalog-status="">1、注册语言</h3>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">1</span> Script.Langs.Set(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">sql</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, SqlLang.Instance);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">2</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 可全局设置为默认语言
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">3</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> Script.Langs.Set("sql", SqlLang.Instance, setDefault: true); </span></pre>
</div>
<h3 id="h_2046348994746511585_4" data-into-catalog-status="">2、单表查询</h3>
<ul>
<li data-pid="zIW5wiwz">select多个字段，生成匿名类型</li>
</ul>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> s = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">@"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">select Name, Age from list where age=10</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 2</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> list = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span>[] { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> Person(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">tom</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">15</span>), <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> Person(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">jim</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">10</span>), <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> Person(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">san</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">20</span>), <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> Person(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">qin</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">10</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) };
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 3</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> script = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Script();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 4</span> script.Context.Langs = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span>[] { <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">sql</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> };
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 5</span> script.Context.SetVar(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">list</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, list);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 6</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> result = script.Eval&lt;IEnumerable&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">dynamic</span>&gt;&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(s).ToList();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 7</span> Assert.AreEqual(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, result.Count);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 8</span> Assert.AreEqual(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">jim</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, result[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">].Name);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 9</span> Assert.AreEqual(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">10</span>, result[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">].Age);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">10</span> Assert.AreEqual(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">qin</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, result[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">].Name);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">11</span> Assert.AreEqual(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">10</span>, result[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>].Age);</pre>

<h3 id="h_2046348994746511585_6" data-into-catalog-status="">4、多表查询</h3>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> s = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">@"</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 2</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">var q1 = new[] { new Person('tom', 20), new Person('jim', 25), new Person('san', 18), new Person('kit', 30) }.AsQueryable();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 3</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">var q2 = new[] { new AddressInfo('jim', 'a'), new AddressInfo('cc', 'b'), new AddressInfo('tom', 'c'), new AddressInfo('ee', 'd') }.AsQueryable();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 4</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">@lang sql
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 5</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">select a.Name, a.Age, b?.Address, case a.Age when 25 then 1 else 2 end as Level
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 6</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">from q1 as a
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 7</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">left join q2 as b on a.Name = b.UserName
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 8</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">where a.age &gt; 22
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 9</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">order by a.age desc
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">10</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">11</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> script = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Script();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">12</span> script.Context.AddType&lt;Person&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">13</span> script.Context.AddType&lt;AddressInfo&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">14</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> list = script.Eval&lt;IEnumerable&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">dynamic</span>&gt;&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(s).ToList();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">15</span> Assert.AreEqual(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, list.Count);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">16</span> Assert.AreEqual(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">kit</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, list[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">].Name);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">17</span> Assert.AreEqual(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">30</span>, list[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">].Age);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">18</span> Assert.AreEqual(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>, list[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">].Level);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">19</span> Assert.IsNull(list[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">].Address);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">20</span> Assert.AreEqual(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">jim</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, list[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">].Name);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">21</span> Assert.AreEqual(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">25</span>, list[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">].Age);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">22</span> Assert.AreEqual(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">a</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, list[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">].Address);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">23</span> Assert.AreEqual(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>, list[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>].Level);</pre>
</div>
<h3 id="h_2046348994746511585_7" data-into-catalog-status="">5、INSERT</h3>
<p>执行insert语句返回插入记录的数量。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> s = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">@"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">insert into list (Name, Age) values ('tom', 20), ('jim', 25)</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 2</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> list = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> List&lt;Person&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 3</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> script = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Script();

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 7</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">    INSERT INTO list (name, age) VALUES(@name, @age)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 8</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">END

<h3 id="h_2046348994746511585_11" data-into-catalog-status="">9、MySql存储过程</h3>
<p data-pid="vms30b6d">如果有多条语句，则使用begin..end，只有一条语句可以不写begin..end。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> s = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">@"</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 2</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">CREATE PROCEDURE AddPerson(@name VARCHAR, @age INT)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 3</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">BEGIN
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 4</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">    DECLARE @name2 VARCHAR
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 5</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">    DECLARE @age2 INT
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 6</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">    SET @name2 = @name + '2'
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 7</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">    SET @age2 = @age + 10
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 8</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">    INSERT INTO list (name, age) VALUES(@name, @age),(@name2, @age2)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 9</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">END
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">10</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">CALL AddPerson('tom', 20)</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">11</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> list = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> List&lt;Person&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">12</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> script = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Script();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">13</span> script.Context.Langs = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span>[] { <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">sql</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> };
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">14</span> script.Context.SetVar(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">list</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, list);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">15</span> Assert.AreEqual(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, script.Eval(s));
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">16</span> Assert.AreEqual(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, list.Count);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">17</span> Assert.AreEqual(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">tom</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, list[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">].Name);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">18</span> Assert.AreEqual(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">20</span>, list[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">].Age);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">19</span> Assert.AreEqual(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">tom2</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, list[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">].Name);

<h3 id="h_2046348994746511585_12" data-into-catalog-status="">10、创建函数</h3>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> s = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">@"</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 2</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">CREATE FUNCTION Calc(@a INT, @b INT)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 3</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">RETURNS INT
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 4</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">BEGIN
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 5</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">    DECLARE @sum INT
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 6</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">    SET @sum = @a * @b + @a + @b
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 7</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">    RETURN @sum
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 8</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">END
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 9</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">SELECT Calc(2, 3)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">10</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">11</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> script = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Script();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">12</span> script.Context.Langs = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span>[] { <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">sql</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> };
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">13</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> result =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> script.Eval(s);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">14</span> Assert.AreEqual(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">11</span>, result);</pre>

<h3 id="h_2046348994746511585_13" data-into-catalog-status="">11、创建表</h3>
<p data-pid="xve4lzzx">表字段支持主键（PRIMARY KEY)、自增（IDENTITY(1,1)或者AUTO_INCREMENT）、默认值（DEFAULT）、可空（NULL）、非空（NOT NULL）、最大长度定义。</p>
<ul>
<li data-pid="lDgWNskQ">简单示例：</li>
</ul>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> s = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">@"</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 2</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">CREATE TABLE person (name varchar, age int)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 3</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">INSERT INTO person (name, age) VALUES ('tom', 20),('jim', 25),('san', 18)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 4</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">UPDATE person SET age = 30 WHERE name = 'tom'
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 5</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">DELETE FROM person WHERE Name = 'jim'
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 6</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">SELECT Name,age FROM person WHERE age &gt; 22
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 7</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 8</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> script = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Script();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 9</span> script.Context.Langs = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span>[] { <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">sql</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> };
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">10</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> list = script.Eval&lt;IEnumerable&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">dynamic</span>&gt;&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(s).ToList();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">11</span> Assert.AreEqual(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, list.Count);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">12</span> Assert.AreEqual(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">tom</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, list[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">].Name);

<h3 id="h_2046348994746511585_14" data-into-catalog-status="">12、SQL to LINQ</h3>
<p data-pid="Y4rDFcHV">项目中我们经常使用LINQ to SQL，如果反过来SQL to LINQ是啥样呢？</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">using</span> (<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> context = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> TestSqliteContext())
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 2</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">{
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 3</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> s = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">@"</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 4</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">select 
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 5</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">    p.Id, 
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 6</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">    p.Name, 
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 7</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">    p.Age, 
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 8</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">    a.Address as MyAddress, 
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 9</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">    case p.Age when 20 then 1 when 22 then 2 else 3 end as Level
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">10</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">from context.Persons as p
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">11</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">left join context.AddressInfos as a on p.Id = a.UserId
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">12</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">13</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> script = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Script();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">14</span>     script.Context.Langs = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span>[] { <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">sql</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> };
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">15</span>     script.Context.SetVar(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">context</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, context);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">16</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> list = script.Eval&lt;IEnumerable&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">dynamic</span>&gt;&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(s).ToList();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">17</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    Console.WriteLine(JsonConvert.SerializeObject(list, Formatting.Indented));
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">18</span> }</pre>
</div>
<p data-pid="1nVWFZFj">我们通过SQL脚本来操作DbContext，实现SQL to LINQ，再由LINQ转SQL（EF Core/FreeSql/SqlSugar等ORM）执行数据库查询操作。</p>
<p data-pid="YybcWEla">生成的SQL语句如下：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">SELECT</span> "p"."Id", "p"."Name", "p"."Age", "a"."Address" <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">AS</span> "MyAddress", <span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 255, 1)">CASE</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">2</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">WHEN</span> "p"."Age" <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">=</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1); font-weight: bold">20</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">THEN</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1); font-weight: bold">1</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">3</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">WHEN</span> "p"."Age" <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">=</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1); font-weight: bold">22</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">THEN</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1); font-weight: bold">2</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">4</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">ELSE</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1); font-weight: bold">3</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">5</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">END</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">AS</span> "<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">Level</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">"
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">6</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">FROM</span> "Persons" <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">AS</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> "p"
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">7</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">LEFT</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">JOIN</span> "AddressInfos" <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">AS</span> "a" <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">ON</span> "p"."Id" <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">=</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> "a"."UserId"
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">8</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">ORDER</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">BY</span> "p"."Age" <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">DESC</span></pre>
</div>
<p data-pid="CW8EIi30">当然，也可以使用SQL脚本对DbContext进行新增、修改、删除操作，同上面的INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE示例。</p>
<h2 id="h_2046348994746511585_15" data-into-catalog-status="">四、应用场景</h2>
<p data-pid="mgR7ELW3">1）前端动态查询条件和排序方式：</p>
<p data-pid="7dUDmBs1">将前端传过来的条件和排序拼接为SQL字符串，然后生成Lambda表达式，如下：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 前端传name、op(=,&gt;,&lt;等比较符)、age</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 2</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">using</span> (<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> context = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> TestSqliteContext())
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 3</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">{
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 4</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 拼接条件字符串</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 5</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> conditionString = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">p.name like %</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>+name+<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">% and p.age</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> + op +<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> age;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 6</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> script = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Script();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 7</span>     script.Context.Langs = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span>[] { <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">sql</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> };
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 8</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 编译条件</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 9</span>     Expression&lt;Func&lt;Person, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">bool</span>&gt;&gt; condition = script.Lambda&lt;Person, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">bool</span>&gt;(conditionString, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">p</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">10</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 条件过滤</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">11</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> result =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> context.Persons.Where(condition).ToList();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">12</span> }</pre>
</div>
<p data-pid="iauUDAVU">2）数据层只提供了IQuerable&lt;T&gt;可是应用层我手痒想写SQL怎么办？</p>
<p data-pid="aP4egiPg">那就用SQL to LINQ吧！</p>
<blockquote>
<p>结束语</p>
</blockquote>
<p data-pid="objdaInG">SQL动态脚本也内置了一些函数，比如：</p>
<ol>
<li data-pid="DIURPc2K">获取当前时间：NOW()或者GETDATE()</li>
<li data-pid="SL0mr8G6">字符串拼接：CONCAT</li>
<li data-pid="gYU-QEfR">计算长度：LEN(字符串或列表)或者LENGTH(字符串或列表)</li>
<li data-pid="7LFGfALE">数学函数：ABS/POW/ROUND/FLOOR/SIN/COS等</li>
</ol>
<p data-pid="mNhjk_9H">SQL脚本可以操作内存列表，操作IQuerable&lt;T&gt;数据源，也可以创建表（DataTable），大家觉得用SQL作为动态脚本如何呢？欢迎留言提供宝贵意见。</p>
<p data-pid="wSP2bibx">AScript开源地址：<a title="https://gitee.com/rockey627/AScript" href="https://gitee.com/rockey627/AScript" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://gitee.com/rockey627/AScript</a></p>
